tagline.en: Moldova's largest carrier — a €0.4/year-to-keep EU-adjacent number, no ID required
tagline.zh: 摩尔多瓦最大运营商——年保号成本约0.4元人民币的号码，无需实名

description.en: Moldtelecom is Moldova's oldest and largest telecom operator. Its eSIM plan costs 40 MDL (~¥17) upfront and ships a Moldovan number that roams in mainland China with free SMS receiving for 6 months plus a 6-month grace period. Keep the number alive with a 1 MDL top-up every 6 months — roughly ¥0.82/year. No real-name registration; Visa/Mastercard payment.
description.zh: Moldtelecom 是摩尔多瓦历史最悠久、规模最大的电信运营商。其eSIM套餐40摩尔多瓦列伊（约17元人民币）起，自带摩尔多瓦号码，中国大陆漫游可免费收短信；开通后6个月有效期+6个月宽限期。每6个月充值1 MDL即可保号，一年约2 MDL（约0.82元人民币）。无需实名，支持Visa/Mastercard支付。

details.en:
Moldtelecom's eSIM is the cheapest documented keep-alive number in this catalogue: the entry eSIM plan costs 40 MDL (~¥17.35), paid with a Visa or Mastercard, and the number works in mainland China right after activation — receiving SMS is free, though calls and outgoing SMS are not supported on the default balance (further top-up required even to test).

Validity: 6 months after activation plus a 6-month grace period during which the number can still receive SMS and dial special numbers (200/300/700) and 112; after the grace period the number is recycled.

Keep-alive: 1 MDL minimum top-up every 6 months — about ¥0.82 per year, the lowest recurring cost reviewed on this site.

Purchase flow (2025-09 source review): pick the eSIM plan on the official site, verify by email code, choose a number (with an 'other numbers' reshuffle option), skip optional add-on packs, pay by card; activation completes in about a minute and three emails arrive (invoice, number info, eSIM QR code). Works on native-eSIM phones via the QR code, or via eSIM-chip readers like Xesim on ordinary phones.

Caveats: no calls/outgoing SMS in China roaming per the source test; Moldova is outside the EU so this is not an EU number for regulatory purposes; and the storefront is Moldovan — expect a mostly non-English checkout.
details.zh:
Moldtelecom的eSIM是本目录中保号成本最低的号码：入门套餐40 MDL（约17.35元），Visa/Mastercard支付，激活后在中国大陆即有漫游信号——收短信免费，但默认余额下不支持接打电话和发短信（需充值更多余额才能测试）。

有效期：激活后6个月+6个月宽限期（宽限期内仍可收短信、接听电话、拨打200/300/700等Moldtelecom业务号码和紧急电话112），宽限期后号码收回。

保号：每6个月最低充值1 MDL——一年约2 MDL（约0.82元人民币），是本站盘点过的最低持有成本。

购买流程（2025-09源测评）：官网选eSIM套餐、邮箱验证码验证、挑选号码（可点other numbers换一批）、附加资源包无需选、刷卡支付；

约一分钟激活完成，收到账单/号码信息/eSIM二维码三封邮件。原生eSIM手机直接扫码，普通手机可用Xesim等eSIM芯片写入。

注意：源实测中国漫游不能通话和发短信；摩尔多瓦非欧盟，号码不具欧盟属性；官网界面以摩尔多瓦语为主。

bestFor.zh: 极限保号党：入门后每年不到1元人民币即可维持一个中国可漫游的号码。
